_comment: global_overnight (session 2026-09-13) — the overseas session read the flex sleeve uses as a CROSS-SECTOR TILT. Asia has closed and Europe is mid-session by the time the collector fires at 09:00 ET; if a sector is being bought hard overseas that is information the US open has not fully absorbed, available before any US price action exists. Config, not hard-coded: the sector map needs maintenance and must not require a code change.
_source_note: P0 probe 2026-09-13 (all results in PR body). REGIONS use FMP /quote on the actual overseas index where the plan allows it (`direct_index` — the real session, no proxy layer): ^N225/^HSI/^FTSE/^STOXX50E returned 200; ^KS11 and ^GDAXI returned HTTP 402 (Restricted Endpoint) and fall back to US-listed country ETFs. /batch-quote-short is also 402, so region reads are one call per symbol. SECTORS have NO index equivalent — an index is regional, not sectoral — so the sector read is necessarily an ADR basket (`adr_proxy`). Alpaca IEX was probed and ELIMINATED on measured evidence: Friday 2026-09-11's 04:00-09:30 ET window returned ONE 1-minute bar per symbol, and the latest IEX quotes are stale/crossed (TSM bid 371.13 / ask 493.24, RIO ask 0) — unusable as prices.
_adr_note: ADRs are preferred over region ETFs for the SECTOR read because a dual-listed ADR is arbitrage-linked to its home session, whereas a US-listed country ETF is US traders' OPINION of that session. Region ETFs are used only where the index itself is plan-restricted.
_sector_proxies_note: FMP `sector` string -> dual-listed ADRs whose HOME session has already traded. Keep keys byte-identical to FMP's own sector strings; a typo silently produces a structurally-absent sector rather than an error.
_structurally_absent_note: These sectors have NO honest overseas proxy — they are structurally domestic. They must read ABSENT, never 0.0. Same distinction `applicable_components` already draws between not_applicable and missing_data, and it matters for the same reason: a sector must never be scored against a bar it cannot structurally clear. Listed explicitly (rather than left to fall out of an absent map key) so the omission is a recorded decision, not an oversight.
